## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(khroma)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(viridis)
```

### Load and preprocess data

```{r}
plot_dir <- "C:/Users/laney/OneDrive/Documents/Symbiosis-Research-2026/mut_rewardx2"
  
tasks <- c("NOT", "NAND", "OR_NOT", "AND", "OR", "AND_NOT", "NOR", "XOR", "EQU")
max_pop_size <- 100 * 100
threshold <- 0.025 * max_pop_size
```

## Load Summary Data

```{r}
summary_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/laney/OneDrive/Documents/Symbiosis-Research-2026/mut_rewardx2/dump/summary.csv")

# Do any universal preprocessing
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    SEED = as.factor(SEED),
    START_MOI = as.factor(START_MOI),
    VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION = as.factor(VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION),
    HEALTH_TYPE = as.factor(HEALTH_TYPE),
    HEALTH_INTERACTION_CHANCE = as.factor(HEALTH_INTERACTION_CHANCE),
    MUTUALIST_CYCLE_GAIN_PROP = as.factor(MUTUALIST_CYCLE_GAIN_PROP),
    PARASITE_CYCLE_LOSS_PROP = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_LOSS_PROP),
    PARASITE_BASE_CYCLE_PROP = as.factor(PARASITE_BASE_CYCLE_PROP),
    MUTUALIST_CYCLE_DONATE_MULTIPLIER = as.factor(MUTUALIST_CYCLE_DONATE_MULTIPLIER), # nolint: line_length_linter.
    PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER), # nolint: line_length_linter.
    HOST_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT = as.factor(HOST_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT),
    SYM_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT = as.factor(SYM_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT),
    EVENTS_CFG_PATH = as.factor(EVENTS_CFG_PATH),
    HOST_REPRO_RES = as.factor(HOST_REPRO_RES)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task_credit = paste0(
      "H", HOST_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT,
      "S", SYM_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT
    ),
    sym_condition = case_when(
      START_MOI == "0" ~ "no-syms",
      START_MOI == "1" & HEALTH_TYPE == "parasite" ~ "parasite",
      START_MOI == "1" & HEALTH_TYPE == "mutualist" ~ "mutualist",
      .default = "unknown" # precaution against unexpected parameterizations
    ),
    interaction_multiplier = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER),
    host_repro_res = as.factor(HOST_REPRO_RES),
    environment = case_when(
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-constant.json" ~ "constant",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-100.json" ~ "fluct-100",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-200.json" ~ "fluct-200",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-500.json" ~ "fluct-500",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-1000.json" ~ "fluct-1000",
      .default = "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    environment = factor(
      environment,
      levels = c(
        "fluct-100",
        "fluct-200",
        "fluct-500",
        "fluct-1000",
        "constant"
      )
    ),
    treatment = paste0(
      sym_condition, "_", host_repro_res, "_", environment
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = as.factor(
      treatment
    )
  )
```

## Load time series data.

```{r}
time_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/laney/OneDrive/Documents/Symbiosis-Research-2026/mut_rewardx2/dump/time_series.csv")

# Do any universal preprocessing
time_data <- time_data %>%
  mutate(
    SEED = as.factor(SEED),
    START_MOI = as.factor(START_MOI),
    HEALTH_TYPE = as.factor(HEALTH_TYPE),
    EVENTS_CFG_PATH = as.factor(EVENTS_CFG_PATH),
    host_repro_res = as.factor(HOST_REPRO_RES)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sym_condition = case_when(
      START_MOI == "0" ~ "no-syms",
      START_MOI == "1" & HEALTH_TYPE == "parasite" ~ "parasite",
      START_MOI == "1" & HEALTH_TYPE == "mutualist" ~ "mutualist",
      .default = "unknown" # precaution against unexpected parameterizations
    ),
    environment = case_when(
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-constant.json" ~ "constant",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-100.json" ~ "fluct-100",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-200.json" ~ "fluct-200",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-500.json" ~ "fluct-500",
      EVENTS_CFG_PATH == "events-fluctuating-1000.json" ~ "fluct-1000",
      .default = "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    environment = factor(
      environment,
      levels = c(
        "fluct-100",
        "fluct-200",
        "fluct-500",
        "fluct-1000",
        "constant"
      )
    ),
    treatment = paste0(
      sym_condition, "_", host_repro_res, "_", environment
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = as.factor(
      treatment
    )
  )
```

## Which runs had hosts and/or symbiont populations that went extinct?

```{r}
sym_min_pop_sizes <- time_data %>%
  group_by(SEED) %>%
  slice_min(
    OrgCounts_hosted_sym_count,
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  slice_min(
    update,
    n = 1
  )

reps_with_extinct_syms <- sym_min_pop_sizes %>%
  group_by(
    treatment
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    reps_with_extinct_syms = sum(OrgCounts_hosted_sym_count == 0)
  )

host_min_pop_sizes <- time_data %>%
  group_by(SEED) %>%
  slice_min(
    OrgCounts_host_count,
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  slice_min(
    update,
    n = 1
  )

reps_with_extinct_hosts <- host_min_pop_sizes %>%
  group_by(
    treatment
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    reps_with_extinct_hosts = sum(OrgCounts_host_count == 0)
  )

extinctions <- full_join(
  reps_with_extinct_syms,
  reps_with_extinct_hosts
)
extinctions <- extinctions %>%
  arrange(
    desc(reps_with_extinct_hosts), desc(reps_with_extinct_syms)
  )
extinction_table <- kable(extinctions) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped")

extinction_table
```

## Task performance all time

### Hosts

Quantify whether tasks have been performed over course of entire run.

```{r}
# Pivot task data long:
# 1) Select only relevant columns
host_over_time_parent_task_data <- time_data %>%
  select(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res,
    update,
    CurUpdate_AND_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_AND_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_EQU_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_NAND_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_NOR_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_OR_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_OR_in_host_parent_org_counts,
    CurUpdate_XOR_in_host_parent_org_counts
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(
      CurUpdate_AND_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_AND_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_EQU_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_NAND_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_NOR_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_OR_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_OR_in_host_parent_org_counts,
      CurUpdate_XOR_in_host_parent_org_counts
    ),
    names_to = "task",
    values_to = "task_in_parent_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task = str_replace(task, "CurUpdate_", "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task = str_replace(task, "_in_host_parent_org_counts", "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task_completed_by_parent = task_in_parent_count >= threshold,
    task = factor(
      task,
      levels = tasks,
      labels = tasks
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task_complexity = case_when(
      task == "NOT" ~ 1,
      task == "NAND" ~ 1,
      task == "OR_NOT" ~ 2,
      task == "AND" ~ 2,
      task == "OR" ~ 3,
      task == "AND_NOT" ~ 3,
      task == "NOR" ~ 4,
      task == "XOR" ~ 4,
      task == "EQU" ~ 5,
      .default = -1
    )
  )

host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task <- host_over_time_parent_task_data %>%
  # filter(update <= 100000) %>%
  group_by(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res,
    task
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    parent_task_completed_ever = any(task_completed_by_parent)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res,
    task
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    parent_tasks_completed_ever = sum(parent_task_completed_ever == TRUE)
  )
```

## Additionally, summarize by task complexity level.

```{r}
host_max_task_complexity_data <- host_over_time_parent_task_data %>%
  group_by(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res,
    task,
    task_complexity
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    parent_task_completed_ever = any(task_completed_by_parent)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # This filter works fine because all replicates start with a task
  filter(
    parent_task_completed_ever
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    max_task_complexity = max(task_complexity)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sym_condition = factor(
      sym_condition,
      levels = c(
        "no-syms",
        "parasite",
        "mutualist"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task <- host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task %>%
  mutate(
    sym_condition = factor(
      sym_condition,
      levels = c(
        "no-syms",
        "parasite",
        "mutualist"
      )
    )
  )
  

host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task_plt1 <- host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = task,
      color = sym_condition,
      fill = sym_condition,
      y = parent_tasks_completed_ever
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = "dodge",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = parent_tasks_completed_ever),
    position = position_dodge(width = 1),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_bright() +
  scale_fill_bright() +
  scale_x_discrete() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 11)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    host_repro_res ~ environment,
    nrow = 1,
    axes = "all_x"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
ggsave(
  file = paste( plot_dir, "host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task_plt.pdf", sep = "/"),
  plot = host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task_plt,
  width = 15,
  height = 8
)
host_parent_tasks_all_time_by_task_plt1
```

## Total different tasks (all time)

```{r}
host_total_different_parent_tasks_all_time <- host_over_time_parent_task_data %>%
  group_by(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res,
    task
  ) %>%
  # Summarize across updates whether task was ever completed by a parent.
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    parent_task_completed_ever = any(task_completed_by_parent)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res
  ) %>%
  # Summarize across tasks (by seed)
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    num_parent_tasks_completed_ever = sum(parent_task_completed_ever == TRUE)
  )
```

## Average number of different tasks evolved?

```{r}
host_avg_tasks_table <- host_total_different_parent_tasks_all_time %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_diff_num_host_parent_tasks = mean(num_parent_tasks_completed_ever)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_diff_num_host_parent_tasks)) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped")

host_avg_tasks_table
save_kable(
  host_avg_tasks_table,
  paste(
    plot_dir,
    "host_avg_diff_num_host_parent_tasks.pdf",
    sep = "/"
  )
)
```

## Maximum task complexity evolved

```{r}
host_max_task_complexity_plt <- host_max_task_complexity_data %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = sym_condition,
      fill = sym_condition,
      y = max_task_complexity
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(color = sym_condition),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      jitter.height = 0.1
    ),
    size = .5,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = .1,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge()
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete() +
  facet_wrap(host_repro_res ~ environment, nrow=1) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
ggsave(
  file = paste(plot_dir, "host_max_task_complexity_plt.pdf", sep = "/"),

)
```

# Task History over time plot

From Kai's Alife stress symbiosis

```{r}
facet_nested_theme <- theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey", linetype="dotted", size = 0.2, linewidth=30), 
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='white', color='grey'),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_rect(color = "transparent"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0,"line"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"line"))
```

```{r}
over_time_tasks_df <- time_data |>
  mutate(treatment = as.factor(treatment)) |>
    group_by(
    SEED,
    treatment,
    sym_condition,
    environment,
    host_repro_res
  ) |>
  filter(update %% 500 == 0) |>
  pivot_longer(col = c(CurUpdate_NAND_in_host_parent_org_counts, CurUpdate_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts, 
               CurUpdate_OR_in_host_parent_org_counts, CurUpdate_OR_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
               CurUpdate_AND_in_host_parent_org_counts, CurUpdate_AND_NOT_in_host_parent_org_counts,
               CurUpdate_NOR_in_host_parent_org_counts, CurUpdate_XOR_in_host_parent_org_counts,
               CurUpdate_EQU_in_host_parent_org_counts), names_to = "parent_task") 
```

```{r, fig.width= 10, fig.height= 10}
treat_list <- levels(over_time_tasks_df$treatment)

host_parent_task_over_time <- over_time_tasks_df |>

  geom_area(aes(fill = parent_task), position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~SEED) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1), legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(
  file = paste0("C:/Users/laney/OneDrive/Documents/Symbiosis-Research-2026/mut_rewardx2/", treat, "_host_parent_task_over_time.pdf"),
  plot = host_parent_task_over_time,
  width = 15,

)
}
```
